supplemented: NewsDesignPage is needed because existing page wrappers cannot express the 16px inset status bar, 42px circular back control, 23px heading and blue background without changing other screens
The grouped seven-asset navigation renderer uses exact nested percentage slots from the cached news JSX; existing LegacyNavigation variants use different vector layers
NewsDesignCard uses a bounded 170x174 native component with percentage asset slots, within responsive flow rows; rows clip shadows as in the design
codeConnect: No CodeConnectSnippet appears in either cached news context; no connected component was bypassed
intentionalDemoDifferences: Search results are counted from actual fixtures: the preview query returns six matches, whereas the design text hardcodes twelve. The unfiltered real list has twelve articles.

Six canonical design stories were added with original titles/photos and synthetic metadata; all titles/person/event references remain unverified demo content. Existing articles use illustrative design photos, not factual photo attribution.

Real lists expose four articles per page with pagination and navigation links. Preview isolates six saved design stories and shows only the first four for the reference composition; saved/liked edits in preview do not update provider state.
The Tái chế pill aliases the Phân loại topic; Sự kiện aliases Cộng đồng. Other active topics are shown as an additional pill, while sort/topic/saved-search choices open reusable sheets.
Unselected save hearts are translucent, selected hearts use the original image unchanged. Like counts update locally.
Long card titles use two lines and retain the full accessible read label; original explicit line breaks are preserved for canonical stories.
